goal: Incrementally improve the app-first Velociraptor candidate by strengthening feather mass and rear-foot sickle-claw cues without breaking the existing tail, two-leg stance, folded forelimbs, or side-profile silhouette.

mustHave: rear-foot raised sickle-claw cue when feet are visible
rejectIf: modern bird body or toothless beak
ordinary lizard feet with no sickle-claw cue

experiments.finding: The v2b local guide gives the clearest folded-arm/torso feather mass and rear-foot cue, but remains too visibly painted for direct app promotion.
Denoise 0.12 lightly naturalizes the local guide while preserving the coarse anatomy gate. Higher denoise values soften the rear-foot cue and make foot review weaker.

decision.status: demoted to reject_reference after direct identity review
decision.reason: The pass is useful negative evidence for feather-mass and rear-foot experiments, but the head reads too bird-like and the rear-foot sickle cue is still not diagnostic enough for representative Velociraptor promotion.
decision.remainingRisk: Exact toe shape, raised second-toe claw anatomy, toothed non-beak head identity, and full dromaeosaur feather coverage still need a custom dromaeosaur LoRA or stronger reference-conditioned generation.
